## Description

Please include a summary of the changes, relevant motivation, and context.

Fixes #(issue)

## Type of Change

- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] ⚡ Performance optimization (INP, memory, or throughput improvements)
- [ ] 🛡️ Security hardening / Cryptographic enhancement
- [ ] 🤖 MCP 2.0 Code Mode / AI Agent enhancement
- [ ] 📖 Documentation / Specification update

## Quality & Verification Checklist

- [ ] My code adheres to the style guidelines of this project (`pnpm run lint` passes).
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code.
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works (`pnpm run test` passes).
- [ ] Zero network requests or telemetry were introduced (client-side air-gap strictly preserved).
- [ ] TypeScript types check cleanly (`pnpm run typecheck` passes).
